data.one_liner: Reusable base class for platform interfaces of Flutter federated plugins.
data.what_it_does: Provides a base class and verification mechanism for platform interfaces of federated Flutter plugins. It enforces that platform implementations extend rather than implement the interface, ensuring safety when new methods are added.
use_when: You are developing a federated Flutter plugin
You want to enforce that platform implementations extend the platform interface class rather than implement it
avoid_when: You are building a standard non-federated app or package
You prefer using Dart 3 base classes exclusively for enforcement without runtime checks
strengths: Enforces best practices for federated plugin architecture
Provides MockPlatformInterfaceMixin for easy mocking and faking in tests
weaknesses: May be considered redundant in Dart 3 projects that can utilize the `base` class modifier directly
